item.title: The Quartermaster
item.description:
Overview

The Quartermaster is a completely group focused support role. You cannot farm solo with this whatsoever.

Aspect Options

  • PvM -> Lyric

Link Options

See build card.

Codex Use

  • Bard

    • Perfect Pitch — Enhances your Lyric abilities and improves the effectiveness of your support.
    • Refrain — Helps maintain your Bard support effects during extended encounters.
    • Self Taught / Virtuoso — Improves overall Lyric support and efficiency.

  • Wizard’s Grimoire

    • Healing — Provides Cure, Arch Cure, and Greater Heal for reliable direct healing.
    • Protection — Provides Bless, Magic Reflect, Protection, Arch Protection, and Reactive Armor.
    • Resurrection & Utility — Provides Resurrection and Create Food for additional group utility.

  • Potion

item.title: Basic Peaceadin
item.description:
Overview

The Basic Peaceadin is a simple and accessible Bard/Dexxer build that combines Peacemaking and Discordance with Chivalry and a traditional melee weapon.

It is designed to provide strong PvM utility while still being capable of dealing consistent melee damage.

Aspect Options

Lyric is the recommended Aspect for this build.

Lyric supports the Bard-focused portion of the template and complements the build’s Peacemaking and Discordance abilities.

Link Options

Chain Links are not a major requirement for this build.
